scope: Representative documented directions in web and interface design, not universal annual winners or a market-share survey.

presets.name: Metro / typography first
presets.description: Rectangular fields, an open grid and emphatic typography.
presets.caveat: Metro predates 2012; these sources document its contemporary articulation.

presets.name: Flat / reduction and clarity
presets.description: Bright accents, reduced ornament and lightweight headings.
presets.caveat: We retain readable weights and visible control boundaries instead of copying extreme thinness.

presets.name: Material / paper layers
presets.description: Elevated paper-like planes, organized color and clear hierarchy.
presets.caveat: The launch dates the direction, not universal adoption that year.

presets.name: Flat 2.0 / quiet depth
presets.description: Mostly flat composition with restrained elevation and explicit affordances.
presets.caveat: The preset keeps clickable controls recognizable, following the usability critique.

presets.name: Duotone / graphic color
presets.description: Two-color fields, bold headings and contrasting graphic accents.
presets.caveat: Without photographs, paired color fields translate image duotone rather than reproduce it literally.

presets.name: Fluent / light and layers
presets.description: Subtle layered materials, spatial hierarchy and light cues.
presets.caveat: A Windows design-system influence, not a claim of web-wide dominance; no Mica/glass equivalence.

presets.name: Material Theming / brand expression
presets.description: Custom color, type and component shape within a coherent system.
presets.caveat: The serif heading and our colors are an illustrative brand treatment, not Google’s exact typeface or palette.

presets.name: Dark mode / restrained light
presets.description: Dark planes, differentiated foreground levels and luminous accents.
presets.caveat: Dark interfaces have earlier histories; 2019 supplies product and web implementation milestones.

presets.name: Soft UI / neumorphism
presets.description: Near-monochrome surfaces and paired raised/recessed shadows.
presets.caveat: Visible borders and focus indicators remain; shadow alone never identifies a control.

presets.name: Glass / translucent layers
presets.description: Frosted panels over diffuse color fields with subtle highlighted edges.
presets.caveat: This is a 2021 visibility lens with older antecedents; no claim that glass was invented then.

presets.name: Material You / tonal roles
presets.description: Coordinated tonal surfaces, rounded controls and generous spacing.
presets.caveat: Uses 2022 expansion and toolkit milestones; Material You was introduced in 2021.

presets.name: Bento / modular compartments
presets.description: Rounded compartments, consistent gaps and a modular visual hierarchy.
presets.caveat: Bento is a documented direction, not a 2023 invention or measured majority style.

presets.name: Expressive editorial / rich graphics
presets.description: Oversized type, assertive lines and restrained patterned graphic accents.
presets.caveat: This translates selected expressive features to a research interface, rather than reproducing maximalist distraction.

presets.name: Material 3 Expressive / shape and focus
presets.description: Varied containment, strongly shaped actions and tonal emphasis.
presets.caveat: A source-specific direction; the optional spring-like motion is not reproduced in this reading tool.

presets.name: Human craft / expressive systems
presets.description: Warm editorial type, paper-like accents and a deliberate color family.
presets.caveat: Forecasts frame this lens; they do not establish that these styles dominated 2026.
